messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On 1 September 2026, does Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (rules on penalties) already apply?

response.text: Il 1 September 2026, l'articolo 50(1) del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 (norme in materia di sanzioni) è già applicabile?
